title: JPMorgan Lifts Its Strategy (MSTR) Stake 36% and Holds $540 Million in Bitcoin ETFs
summary: Bitcoin Magazine JPMorgan Lifts Its Strategy (MSTR) Stake 36% and Holds $540 Million in Bitcoin ETFs A 13F filed Thursday shows JPMorgan held 848,932 Strategy shares, up 36% from June, and 11.4 million IBIT shares worth $540 million at Sept. 30, weeks before MSCI's index exit. This post JPMorgan Lifts Its Strategy (MSTR) Stake 36% and Holds $540 Million in Bitcoin ETFs first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
